plans.idea: Faithful left-to-right split like the original: brand, headline and CTA stacked on a shared left edge, then the warm ember image with the phone standing beside it as a product accent on the right.
Mirrored split: image block (ember backdrop plus phone) anchors the left, and the brand-headline-CTA column reads top to bottom on the right half.
Symmetric triptych: ember image on the left, phone on the right, and a centred brand-headline-CTA stack in the middle as the clear focal point.
